Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_UNASSIGNED
Icon.description: MUST NOT be advertised for Installer Icon Type. An application GUI SHOULD show this icon for any unknown generic icon type. If a known generic icon type can be determined from an unknown specific icon type, an application GUI SHOULD NOT show this icon but rather show the generic icon type.

Icon.description: Generic Light Dimmer icon. This icon is intended for user icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH_PLUGIN
Icon.description: Light Dimmer, implemented as a plugin device. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH_WALL_OUTLET

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH_CEILING_OUTLET

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH_WALL_LAMP
Icon.description: Light Dimmer, implemented as a wall mounted lamp. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH_LAMP_POST_HIGH
Icon.description: Light Dimmer, implemented as a ceiling outlet. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH_LAMP_POST_LOW
Icon.description: Light Dimmer, implemented as a ceiling outlet. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH_DIN_RAIL_MODULE
Icon.description: Light Dimmer, implemented as a DIN Rail module. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_ON_OFF_POWER_SWITCH
Icon.description: Generic Relay device icon. This icon is intended for user icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_POWER_SWITCH_PLUGIN
Icon.description: Relay device, implemented as a plugin device. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.description: Relay device, implemented as a wall outlet. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_POWER_SWITCH_CEILING_OUTLET
Icon.description: Relay device, implemented as a ceiling outlet. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_POWER_SWITCH_WALL_LAMP
Icon.description: Relay device, implemented as a wall mounted lamp. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_POWER_SWITCH_LAMP_POST_HIGH
Icon.description: Relay device, implemented as a ceiling outlet. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_POWER_SWITCH_LAMP_POST_LOW
Icon.description: Relay device, implemented as a ceiling outlet. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.description: Relay device, implemented as a DIN Rail module. This icon is intended for installer icon types

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_POWER_STRIP
Icon.description: Power Strip. Individual outlets of a power strip should be assigned the following installer type icon: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_POWER_STRIP_INDIVIDUAL_OUTLET. Individual outlets of a power strip should be assigned one of the following user type icons: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH, ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_ON_OFF_POWER_SWITCH.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_POWER_STRIP_INDIVIDUAL_OUTLET
Icon.description: Individual outlet of a power strip for showing outlets in exploded view

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_SENSOR_NOTIFICATION_MULTIDEVICE
Icon.description: Bundled Alarm sensors. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing multiple alarm functions. A user interface should not show the root device. Individual End Points of the multi-alarm device may be assigned any alarm icon

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_SENSOR_MULTILEVEL_VOLATILE_ORGANIC_COMPOUND_LEVEL
Icon.description: Multilevel Sensor: Volatile Organic Compound level

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_SENSOR_MULTILEVEL_DOMESTIC_HOT_WATER_TEMPERATURE
Icon.description: Multilevel Sensor: Domestic Hot Water temperature

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_SENSOR_MULTILEVEL_WATER_OXIDATION_REDUCTION_POTENTIAL
Icon.description: Multilevel Sensor: Water Oxidation reduction potential

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_SENSOR_MULTILEVEL_MULTIDEVICE
Icon.description: Multilevel Sensor; Bundled Sensors. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing multiple sensor functions. A user interface should not show the root device. Individual End Points of the multi-sensor device may be assigned any sensor icon

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_SUB_ENERGY_METER
Icon.description: Sub Energy Meter. NOTE: This icon type represents a meter. Early versions of this list suggested a sample icon which depicted a multilevel sensor style device.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_THERMOSTAT
Icon.description: Thermostat. This version is generic and may be used in place for all specific variants.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_THERMOSTAT_LINE_VOLTAGE
Icon.description: Thermostat, Line Voltage switching. This version is explicitly intended to represent line voltage thermostats. A line voltage thermostat is directly switching the system power. It is most commonly used for electric space heaters.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_THERMOSTAT_SETBACK
Icon.description: Thermostat; Setback type. This version is explicitly intended to represent programmable thermostats. A setback thermostat may reduce or increase the temperature at different times of the day.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_WALL_CONTROLLER
Icon.description: Wall Controller. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device. The user icon type of each wall controller End Point should be either ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH, ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_ON_OFF_POWER_SWITCH.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_REPEATER
Icon.description: Repeater. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in a repeater device. In a special case, this icon type may be used for a Multi Channel End Point that represents the radio interface; for instance if the radio interface has its own battery power supply. An installer interface should show this icon. A user interface should not show this icon.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_DIMMER_WALL_SWITCH
Icon.description: Dimmer Wall Switch. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device. The user icon type of each wall controller End Point should be either ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH, ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_ON_OFF_POWER_SWITCH.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_DIMMER_WALL_SWITCH_ONE_BUTTON
Icon.description: Dimmer Wall Switch, 1 button. This icon is intended for the installer icon type of a Multi Channel End Point in a wall controller - or of the root device of a one-button wall controller.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_DIMMER_WALL_SWITCH_TWO_BUTTONS
Icon.description: Dimmer Wall Switch, 2 buttons. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_DIMMER_WALL_SWITCH_THREE_BUTTONS
Icon.description: Dimmer Wall Switch, 3 buttons. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_DIMMER_WALL_SWITCH_FOUR_BUTTONS
Icon.description: Dimmer Wall Switch, 4 buttons. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_DIMMER_WALL_SWITCH_ONE_ROTARY
Icon.description: Dimmer Wall Switch, 1 rotary knob. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_ON_OFF_WALL_SWITCH
Icon.description: On/Off Wall Switch. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device. The user icon type of each wall controller End Point should be either ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_LIGHT_DIMMER_SWITCH, ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_ON_OFF_POWER_SWITCH.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_WALL_SWITCH_ONE_BUTTON
Icon.description: On/Off Wall Switch, 1 button. This icon is intended for the installer icon type of a Multi Channel End Point in a wall controller - or of the root device of a one-button wall controller.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_WALL_SWITCH_TWO_BUTTONS
Icon.description: On/Off Wall Switch, 2 buttons. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_WALL_SWITCH_THREE_BUTTONS
Icon.description: On/Off Wall Switch, 3 buttons. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_WALL_SWITCH_FOUR_BUTTONS
Icon.description: On/Off Wall Switch, 4 buttons. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_WALL_SWITCH_DOOR_BELL
Icon.description: Door Bell (button). This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types of a Door Bell user input device, i.e. the device which sits next to the door on the outside. The device may communicate to e.g. a gateway or a siren.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ON_OFF_WALL_SWITCH_ONE_ROTARY
Icon.description: Wall Switch, 1 rotary knob. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types in the root device of a Multi Channel device implementing a wall controller. A user interface should not show the root device.

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_BARRIER
Icon.description: Barrier. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types of an access control system

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_IRRIGATION
Icon.description: Irrigation. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types of an irrigation control system

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_GENERIC_ENTRY_CONTROL
Icon.description: Entry Control. This icon is intended for the installer and user icon types of an entry control system

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ENTRY_CONTROL_RFID_TAG_READER_NO_BUTTON
Icon.description: Entry Control RFID tag reader, no button

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ENTRY_CONTROL_KEYPAD_0_9_OK_CANCEL
Icon.description: Entry control keypad 0-9 with ok and cancel buttons

Icon.name: ICON_TYPE_SPECIFIC_ENTRY_CONTROL_KEYPAD_0_9_OK_CANCEL_HOME_STAY_AWAY
Icon.description: Entry control keypad 0-9 with ok, cancel, home, stay and away buttons
